entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A human Planeswalker from Avishkar and a pyromancer centered in red mana. She is a member of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The oath-bound group of Planeswalkers formed on Zendikar to stand together against threats no one of them could face alone.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane, where fire magic was strictly banned when she was young.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The region of Kaladesh that Chandra comes from.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh where Chandra's family lived and where the Consulate holds its arena and Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane where Chandra went after her first planeswalk and where Keral Keep stands.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: A monastery on Regatha founded around the teachings of Jaya Ballard, where Chandra studied pyromancy and later became abbot.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire-wielding Planeswalker whose teachings are the core of Keral Keep's beliefs. She turned out to be the same person as Chandra's mentor Mother Luti.

entities.name: Serenok
entities.description: Chandra's mentor at Keral Keep, whose death led to her election as abbot.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage Planeswalker and member of the Gatewatch who repeatedly crosses paths with Chandra.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker and Gatewatch member who began as an agent of the Order and later sacrificed his life to save Liliana.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker and Gatewatch member who becomes Chandra's lover.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer Planeswalker who joins and aids the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin Planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and later works as a Strixhaven professor.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A Planeswalker with a metallic arm who served as the Consulate's Head Judge on Kaladesh and is Nicol Bolas's servant.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate officer on Kaladesh who holds the Dhund and who Chandra has reason to hate.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, an inventor and rogue artificer who later becomes Consul of Allocation.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's father, who created her Regulator.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon Planeswalker who manipulated Chandra and led the war on Ravnica.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-aligned Planeswalker who guards the Eye of Ugin on Zendikar.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A ruin sage on Zendikar and leader of the League of Anowon who betrays Chandra.

entities.name: Walbert
entities.description: The leader of the Order of Heliud, who planned to strip Chandra of her magic with the Purifying Fire.

entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: A multiplanar organization promising peace, order and law that took over much of Regatha.

entities.name: Velrav
entities.description: A vampire ruler of Diraden whose death ended the plane's eternal night.

entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: A plane shrouded in eternal night, ruled by a vampire, whose only mana is black.

entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: An ancient artifact that cleanses a person's soul of sins and imperfections.

entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: A scroll Chandra stole from the Sanctum of Stars, tied to Zendikar and to Ramaz's scheme.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: The plane containing Aretopolis and the Sanctum of Stars.

entities.name: Sanctum of Stars
entities.description: A museum of artifacts of great power and value on Kephalai, destroyed during Chandra's attack.

entities.name: Ramaz
entities.description: An insane shaman who manipulated Chandra into stealing the Dragon Scroll, subservient to a dragon.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Chandra confronted Ramaz.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of erratic mana where the Eldrazi Titans were released and destroyed.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan destroyed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan destroyed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan that the Gatewatch fought on Innistrad.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon Planeswalker who took Gideon, Jace and Nissa prisoner on Zendikar.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane where the Battle of Thraben and the Eternal Night took place.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city on Innistrad destroyed and filled with zombies.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the Gatewatch had its headquarters and Bolas's invasion took place.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas built an army of Eternals and defeated the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where the Gatewatch fought Belzenlok and where Chandra later fought on Liliana's trail.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon on Dominaria whom the Gatewatch sought to kill with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that Bolas used to trap Planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Vedalken Consulate official who serves Tezzeret and later Bolas, and has an Immortal Sun facility on Ravnica.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A shapeshifter who disguised himself as Chandra during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon Planeswalker who severed Baan's right hand as proof of a kill.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A half-devil Planeswalker who fed on Chandra's agony.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf Planeswalker from Innistrad who sought the Gatewatch's help.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar of Innistrad toward whom Chandra expressed attraction.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time-manipulating Planeswalker who helped on Innistrad and during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A Planeswalker who scouted Thraben and carried the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who took the Moonsilver Key and began the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: The lasting darkness brought about when Olivia Voldaren took the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: A key that restores balance between night and day on Innistrad.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A Planeswalker who merged with Realmbreaker to switch the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A Planeswalker who ascended and intervened in New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane that the Planeswalkers invaded.

entities.name: Cloudspire Racing Team
entities.description: The reigning champion team of the Ghirapur Grand Prix, which Chandra joined.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A death-defying interplanar circuit race whose champion wins the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven where Chandra met the Shattered.

entities.name: Shattered
entities.description: A group of former Oriq pyromancers that Chandra took under her wing.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic that Chandra believed was Jace's vessel for his plan.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A place on Arcavios where the Dawning Archaic attacked and Chandra's blast opened a chasm.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: A copy-realm where Jace made his sanctum and where alternate versions of the planeswalkers live.

entities.name: Theorist
entities.description: A cold and determined aspect of Jace's splintered personality.

events.summary: In a flashback to her youth on Kaladesh, Chandra sets off a huge blast of fire to scare off her parents and runs away to the mountains.
events.quote: In an attempt to scare off her parents, she set off a huge blast of fire that caught several of the village huts on fire, before running away to the mountains.

events.summary: Facing execution after her village is burned, Chandra's spark ignites and she planeswalks to Regatha for the first time.
events.quote: This traumatic moment ignited her Planeswalker spark, sending her to Regatha

events.summary: The page says Chandra's account was not the whole truth: the soldiers of the Consuls lit the fire in the village.
events.quote: The fire in the village wasn't lit by Chandra but by the soldiers of the Consuls, who were persecuting her.

events.summary: Chandra steals the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars.
events.quote: There, Chandra stole a scroll known as the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars

events.summary: Jace tracks Chandra down at Keral Keep and fights her; he wins and completes his mission.
events.quote: Jace confronted her, and a fight broke out.

events.summary: Chandra's attack on soldiers destroys the entire Sanctum of Stars, killing everyone inside.
events.quote: her attack on a group of soldiers caused the entire Sanctum of Stars, a museum of artifacts and rarities of great power and value, to be destroyed, killing all those inside

events.summary: Chandra and Gideon escape captivity on Diraden through a plan that ends in the death of Prince Velrav and the end of the plane's eternal night.
events.quote: she concocted a plan of escape with Gideon that culminated in the death of Velrav

events.summary: Gideon reveals that he is an agent for the Order.
events.quote: Gideon revealed that he was an agent for the Order

events.summary: Chandra enters the Purifying Fire with a clean soul; it accepts her and she destroys the Order's forces, burning Walbert to death.
events.quote: burning Walbert and many others to death and cracking the very foundations of the cavern

events.summary: Chandra decides to leave Regatha and seek out Zendikar.
events.quote: She decided to leave the plane of Regatha forever and seek out the mystically powerful plane of Zendikar.

events.summary: Anowon betrays Chandra and tries to kill her in her sleep; Sarkhan knocks him unconscious.
events.quote: Luckily for Chandra, Sarkhan Vol ambushed Anowon, rendering him unconscious with a swift strike to the head.

events.summary: With Jace's help, Chandra casts a fire spell that cannot be seen and brings down the transformed Sarkhan.
events.quote: With his encouragement, she cast a fire spell that could not be seen

events.summary: Chandra confronts Ramaz on Kaldheim; he escapes, revealing he served a greater dragon.
events.quote: After a skirmish, he escaped, revealing that he had only been a minion in a yet greater scheme

events.summary: After Serenok's death, Chandra is elected the new abbot of Keral Keep.
events.quote: After her mentor Serenok died, she was elected to become the new abbot.

events.summary: Chandra arrives at the Battle for Zendikar and frees Gideon, Jace and Nissa from Ob Nixilis, scaring the demon off.
events.quote: She managed to free them, and through a concerted attack they finally scared the demon away from the plane.

events.summary: The four Planeswalkers swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

events.summary: Channeling her flame through Zendikar's ley lines, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

events.summary: At the Battle of Thraben the Gatewatch is saved by Liliana; Chandra then defends the others during the sealing of Emrakul.
events.quote: When it became clear that they could not destroy Emrakul, Chandra joined Gideon in defending the other members of the Gatewatch while they conducted the sealing ritual.

events.summary: On Kaladesh, Chandra recognizes the rogue artificer Renegade Prime as her mother Pia.
events.quote: Chandra recognized Renegade Prime as her presumed dead mother, Pia

events.summary: Baral traps Chandra and Nissa in the Deadlock Trap; Ajani frees them.
events.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

events.summary: Chandra and her mother are reunited after the confrontation with the Head Judge.
events.quote: Chandra and her mother are finally reunited.

events.summary: Chandra volunteers to use her fire as a detonator in the thopter, helping destroy Tezzeret's planar bridge.
events.quote: Chandra volunteered to enter the thopter and use her fire magic as a detonator instead.

events.summary: Pia becomes the new Consul of Allocation and Baral is imprisoned in the Dhund.
events.quote: with Pia becoming the new Consul of Allocation and Baral being imprisoned in the Dhund

events.summary: The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas on Amonkhet and Chandra, badly wounded, planeswalks away.
events.quote: Chandra was severely wounded and had to abandon her friends by planeswalking away.

events.summary: On Dominaria, Chandra learns Jaya is her mentor Mother Luti and restores Multani's consciousness, persuading Jaya to help.
events.quote: Using some of Nissa's techniques, she restored Multani's consciousness.

events.summary: Chandra helps disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.
events.quote: This deception allowed the real Chandra to sneak into Baan's facility and disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.

events.summary: As part of Gideon's plan, Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun to keep Bolas from planeswalking away.
events.quote: she reactivated the Immortal Sun to prevent Bolas from planeswalking away

events.summary: Gideon sacrifices his life to save Liliana; Chandra believes Liliana killed him and is stopped by Jace.
events.quote: When Gideon sacrificed his life to save Liliana, Chandra misunderstood what had happened, believing Liliana had killed him.

events.summary: After the war, Chandra and Nissa profess their love for each other.
events.quote: After, Chandra and Nissa professed their love for each other

events.summary: Hunting Baan on Regatha, Chandra unknowingly helps Vraska's plan as Vraska severs Baan's hand to fake his death.
events.quote: Vraska severed Baan’s right hand to use as proof of a kill while Chandra believed she had delivered the killing blow.

events.summary: On Amonkhet, Chandra obliterates the idol of Nicol Bolas, symbolically defeating the foe that haunted her.
events.quote: There, she unleashed her rage, obliterating the statue; symbolically defeating the foe that had haunted her.

events.summary: Chandra finds peace with herself and knocks out Tibalt, delivering him to the authorities on Innistrad.
events.quote: she knocked him out and delivered him to the local authorities to deal with

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the witches' ritual and takes the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night.
events.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

events.summary: With the balance restored, Arlinn sees Chandra and Adeline together under a willow tree, talking and embracing.
events.quote: After the balance between night and day was restored, Arlinn Kord observed Chandra and Adeline together, hidden away under a willow tree as they talked and embraced.

events.summary: Chandra learns that Nissa and Jace fell to the enemy and is the only one willing to return to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Chandra was devastated to learn that Nissa and Jace had also fallen to the enemy.

events.summary: Elspeth intervenes; Chandra and Koth fight to the tree and Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Wrenn managed to fuse with Realmbreaker.

events.summary: Nissa is un-compleated and Chandra chooses to stay with the desparked Nissa.
events.quote: Chandra chose to stay with the desparked Nissa

events.summary: Chandra joins the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team, in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: Chandra chose to join the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team

events.summary: Jace attacks the racers in Avishkar, rendering them unconscious and taking Loot back; Chandra is badly hurt.
events.quote: Jace rendered them unconscious, taking the child back.

events.summary: Chandra attacks the Dawning Archaic at Titan's Grave, plunging everyone into a chasm.
events.quote: resulting in it falling and plunging them all into a chasm below Titan's Grave

events.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist, Jace's mind is reunited, and he dies peacefully after telling Chandra she was like family.
events.quote: He reached out to his rescuers, telling Chandra she had been like family to him and apologizing for his coldness toward her, and died peacefully.

events.summary: Emrakul appears and consumes the collapsing Echoverse, saving the Multiverse; Chandra escapes to Vryn.
events.quote: Emrakul appeared overhead and began to consume it, preventing it from colliding with the original Multiverse.

relations.quote: She is a member of the Gatewatch

relations.quote: She studied under Jaya to learn better control over her pyromancy.
